subject: general
question: What is the area of a right-angled triangle, the length of whose sides are 10 cm, 24 cm and 26 cm?
solution:
**Given:**

The sides of the triangle are 10 cm, 24 cm, and 26 cm

**Concept used:**

Area of a triangle = 1/2 × base × height

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea18fb274401f41d4de81116e6489ddd388a9a6e8da15116ef2636c5d479767b.png] 

Here,

AB = Height = 10 cm and BC = Base = 24 cm

So, the area of the right angle triangle = 1/2 × 10 × 24

⇒ 5 × 24

⇒ 120 cm²

**∴ The area of a right-angled triangle is 120 cm2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Here 10, 24, and 26 are the pythagorean triplets.
